data.summary: Attempt 2 passes. The factory-supplied npm test run exited 0 with 61 tests passing, 0 failing and 0 skipped, and npm run build exited 0 with 4 pages built. All eight acceptance criteria are satisfied by code inspection. The live-browser checks (no-flash reload, modal open/close, aria-expanded toggling) are verified only statically, because I had no http-probe or dev server. One non-blocking privacy defect remains: sign colouring is still applied to masked values.

npm run build (cwd ui/; pre-executed by factory)

e2eChecks.name: Header brand, Home/About active state, PrivacyToggle and ThemeToggle
e2eChecks.expected: Brand, Home and About links with aria-current on the active one, PrivacyToggle and ThemeToggle rendered
e2eChecks.actual: All present; links use aria-current=page when active; both toggles rendered with client:load. Verified by reading only.

e2eChecks.name: Mobile menu aria-expanded
e2eChecks.request: Static read of Header.astro inline script
e2eChecks.expected: Button toggles aria-expanded and menu visibility on click
e2eChecks.actual: Click handler negates aria-expanded and toggles hidden/flex on #mobile-menu. Not run in a browser.

e2eChecks.name: Theme toggle class and persistence
e2eChecks.request: Static read of ThemeToggle.jsx, lib/theme.js and Layout.astro head script
e2eChecks.expected: dark class on html, value stored under 'theme', no flash on reload
e2eChecks.actual: applyTheme toggles 'dark' on the root and writes localStorage 'theme'; a blocking inline head script applies the theme before paint. Verified by reading only.

e2eChecks.name: Summary KPI cards for total and organic
e2eChecks.expected: Invested, Obtained, Benefit, Profit in a collapsible organic section
e2eChecks.actual: SummaryRow renders four KpiCards; organic section is behind an aria-expanded button. Verified by reading.

e2eChecks.name: Profit and benefit coloured by sign; masked in privacy mode
e2eChecks.request: Static read of Summary.jsx and currencyAdapter.js
e2eChecks.expected: Sign colour on profit and benefit; masked text when privacy is on
e2eChecks.actual: Values are masked to '******'. signClass still colours the masked value by sign (see bugReports[0]).

e2eChecks.name: Home skeleton while loading
e2eChecks.actual: HomeSkeleton returned while loading; LoadingSpinner import removed.

e2eChecks.name: BaseModal props, Escape, backdrop, dialog role
e2eChecks.request: Static read of modals/BaseModal.jsx and its three call sites
e2eChecks.expected: Same props; Escape and backdrop close; role=dialog and aria-modal=true; existing modals wired
e2eChecks.actual: Props kept; Escape handler; backdrop onClick=onClose with inner stopPropagation; role and aria-modal set. ForecastGraphModal, CombinedForecastGraphModal and InvestmentGraphModal still use BaseModal with onClose. Not opened in a browser.

e2eChecks.name: Tailwind config and CSS tokens
e2eChecks.request: Static read of tailwind.config.mjs and styles/global.css
e2eChecks.expected: darkMode 'class'; semantic tokens backed by CSS variables for light and dark
e2eChecks.actual: darkMode: 'class'; tokens are hsl(var(--x) / <alpha-value>); :root and .dark define the variables.

e2eChecks.name: Build and tests green
e2eChecks.request: npm run build; npm test in ui/
e2eChecks.expected: Both exit 0; existing tests unchanged and passing

evidence: No .skip, .only, @Disabled or todo markers found in ui/src.
The diff only adds test files (currencyAdapter.test.js, theme.test.js) and modifies no existing test file.
The ForecastUtils, ChartUtils and datetimeFormater suites pass in the run output and are not modified in the diff.

bugReports.title: Profit and Benefit keep sign colouring in privacy mode, leaking the sign of the masked value
stepsToReproduce: Set localStorage privacyMode to 'true' and load /invest-track/.
Look at the Benefit and Profit cards in the Total and Organic sections.
Observe the masked '******' is coloured text-success when positive and text-danger when negative.
bugReports.expected: In privacy mode the masked values reveal no sign, consistent with the badge hidden in the same change.
bugReports.actual: Summary.jsx passes signClass(benefit) and signClass(profit) regardless of isPrivate, so colour reveals the hidden sign.
bugReports.evidence: ui/src/components/investments/Summary.jsx lines 57 and 63 pass valueClassName={signClass(...)} without checking isPrivate; line 65 hides the badge with !isPrivate.

data.recommendation: In ui/src/components/investments/Summary.jsx, make the sign colour neutral when isPrivate is true: pass valueClassName={isPrivate ? undefined : signClass(benefit)} on the Benefit card and the equivalent for profit on the Profit card, or extend signClass to take isPrivate. Also decide whether the edit to ui/src/lib/currencyAdapter.js fits the criterion 'No chart component or lib service file is modified except for the new theme utility'. It is a lib file, so either move formatPercentForPrivacy elsewhere or record the exception explicitly.
